_doc: Chests, keys and the bush mimic (docs/decisions/0007-keys-and-cover.md; scripts/match/key_run.gd, chest_loot.gd, shrubling.gd). There is one chest type. It is locked: opening it costs one key. Keys come from monsters: in every region the number of key carriers equals the number of chests there. Which monsters carry them is rolled per match on its own seeded stream (seed_mul / seed_add).

chest.keep_doc: Share of the map's chests and of the item caches a match places (owner 11-10: about 40% fewer). Vaults are not cut. KeyChest.thin drops the most crowded map chests first. Change it with the bonus key odds in chest_keys.json (the --keys-check surplus).
chest.creak_doc: The lid's sound as it opens, by the chest's tier: its rarity bonus (ChestLoot.rarity_bonus: the region's bonus, a dangerous area's step and the match tier's). The last one plays for anything richer.

keys.cap_doc: Chest keys one hunter can hold (a belt stack). Past it a key stays on the ground, glinting.
